name: Summoned Creature: Giant Ant Soldier — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Summoned Creature: Giant Ant Drone", "Summoned Creature: Giant Spider" but are not part of the Summoned Creature: Giant Ant Soldier entry, which is unchanged.
